notes.title: BVRGER VAN V1.2 Career Update
notes.content:
The time is finally upon us, the long-awaited release of the [b]BVRGER VAN[/b] Career update! It's time for you to earn your way to burger van glory!
The Infinite mode has also seen some rather big changes in this update so make sure you check that out!

[b][u]Patch Notes[/u][/b]

+ Career Mode with challenging progression

+ Massive changes to Infinite mode gameplay

+ New environments

- Optimisation tweaks

Thank you for the continued support throughout the development of [b]BVRGER VAN[/b]. We love to hear your feedback on ways we can improve the experience for all. Watch this space for more interesting updates to come!

notes.title: BVRGER VAN Update v1.1
notes.content:
BVRGER VAN v1.1 is now upon us with a few new features added to the core gameplay experience. By request, we have added a radio into the game with the ability to add your own music and dance the night away!

[b][u] Patch Notes [/u][/b]

+ Radio added to infinite mode. To play custom music, add .wav and .ogg files to the "Music" folder in your install directory to play them in game

+ Shutter added to the van which has to be opened to start each day

- Environment optimisation to improve overall performance

- Updated to latest version of Unity editor for improved stability


Thank you for your patience and support during the development of BVRGER VAN. More updates are coming at the end of this week so don't go anywhere!

notes.title: BVRGER VAN Hotfix v1.01
notes.content:
Thank you all very much for supporting BVRGER VAN on its release! A few tweaks have been made to the game for a more stable and enjoyable experience.

[b][u]Patch Notes[/u] [/b] 

+ Ability to toggle music on and off

+ Quit button in main menu

+ Return to main menu button in Infinite mode

- Tweaked time it takes to unlock new food in Infinite mode

- Minor performance and optimisation updates

More updates will be rolling out over the coming days and weeks so watch this space for more info!
